description: Packages defined for GNU Guix, including packages provided by the official and third-party Guix channels.

repository.note: The default repository is the official GNU Guix channel. Additional channels can be identified using the namespace and repository_url qualifier.

namespace_definition.note: The namespace identifies the Guix channel providing the package. It is required for consistency across all Guix PURLs. Use 'guix' for the official GNU Guix channel, yielding PURLs such as pkg:guix/guix/<name>. For packages from other channels, use the corresponding channel name (e.g. 'nonguix' or 'guix-science') as the namespace and provide the repository_url qualifier to identify the channel's Git repository. Channel names are not globally unique, so the repository_url qualifier helps distinguish channels with the same name.

name_definition.note: The name is the Guix package name.

version_definition.note: The version is the Guix package version.

qualifiers_definition.description: The selected output of the Guix package. Output names are package-specific; examples include 'out', 'bin', 'lib', 'doc', and 'debug'. When omitted, the default 'out' output is assumed.

The URL of the Git repository containing the Guix channel and package definitions. This qualifier should be provided for non-default channels to identify their repository. It is not the upstream source repository URL or a binary substitute server URL.
